info.name: VID Event Callback (identity-service)
info.description:
Postman collection for VidEventCallbackController (MOSIP id-repository, id-repository-identity-service).

Base path: /idrepository/v1/identity (port 8090).

This is a WebSub callback endpoint — normally invoked by the WebSub hub with intent verification and an HMAC signature; manual calls may be rejected.

request.description: POST /callback/vid_credential_status_update — handles VID credential status events. If data.status equals the configured VID active status, consumes request/response as credential request; otherwise consumes data.idaEvent.
